name: Zatsuon-kei Shounen Shoujo
source:
Welcome to Noise Scramble City—a maze-like metropolis reminiscent of Tokyo. Six young individuals awaken downtown in a mental prison of their own making with no memory of their arrival. Now they must solve intricate mysteries to piece together fragments of their pasts and ultimately escape this enigmatic alternate reality.

[from [url=https://www.gematsu.com/2024/11/type-noise-shonen-shojo-hiyori-chapter-demo-launches-today]Gematsu[/url]]
translation:
欢迎来到“杂音闹市”——一座酷似东京的迷宫都市。六名失去来时记忆的少年少女在闹市街头醒来，发现自己被困在由各自内心构筑的精神牢狱之中。如今，他们必须解开错综复杂的谜题，拼凑出过往记忆的碎片，最终逃离这个扑朔迷离的异度空间。

[摘自[url=https://www.gematsu.com/2024/11/type-noise-shonen-shojo-hiyori-chapter-demo-launches-today]Gematsu[/url]]
